entities.summary: Nicolaas van Nieuwland, or Nicolas Van Nienlant was a Dutch Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Haarlem and abbot of Egmond Abbey from 1562 to 1569 and as Auxiliary Bishop of Utrecht (1541–?).
